EmailTemplate.subject: Can you reduce DSO for international customers?
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi {{lead.First Name:default=Friend}}, You understand how challenging it can be to satisfy customers in other parts of the world, especially when it comes to payments.
The transaction and handling of payments from one country to another involves a complex FX landscape. Even your invoicing <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/an-introduction-to-cross-border-invoicing-and-business-payments?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]> may have local regulations governing what an invoice must look like and the method of delivery.
Flywire’s latest industry research shows that 95% of your peers believe that if they could deal with exchange rates in an easier way, they would increase their global expansion efforts.
If you start invoicing your payers with local options, compliant presentations, and a top-notch payment experience, you can guarantee timely international payments and reduced DSO. We put together 5 steps to invoicing international customers <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/an-introduction-to-cross-border-invoicing-and-business-payments?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]> and the considerations your team should make in building out a cross-border payments capability.
Let me know if this was helpful, I would be happy to provide other resources for you and your team,
Josh Easterly
